title: DCS raw prompt artifact (custody record)
description: Immutable, tenant-scoped record of the exact model-visible prompt bytes. prompt_sha256 is the identity of the RAW UTF-8 bytes; normalized_prompt_digest is the rule-engine view used by PlanIR v0.1 and is NOT an identity of model-visible text (P01R2 review F3). An executor may hydrate prompt bytes only through handle, only for the owning tenant, and must include prompt_sha256 in every execution input digest / cache key. P02 ships the contract and storage; binding into PlanIR is a P03 prerequisite for any inference.
